clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move across the country in March 1952, within the year: June's homesickness and daily letters to her sister, Walter working long hours in the trees and distance from June, Glen's fights at school, Walter's cutoff from his brother Harlan over their father's land money, June kept to her bed for weeks that first winter, Walter and June's rows over money for new trees, and by September June joined the church choir and her letters thinned out. These shifts in anxiety, functioning, and relationship moves pile up from the move through the following year as the family settled into the valley.

clusters.name: The orchard failed, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when the late frost took the crop and the bank called in the loan, within the year: Walter's heavy drinking, conflict between Walter and Glen over who was to blame, Glen and Marian taking over the family's money and talks with the bank, Carl's asthma attacks that winter, Nora beginning to wet the bed again in spring, Ida's heart trouble found in May, and Walter stopped drinking and took work pruning in October. The shifts in symptom, functioning, and relationship moves pile up as the family faced the loss of the orchard and moved to Ridgeport.

clusters.name: Glen lost his job at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen's job loss in February 1975 when the cannery closed, within the year: Glen out of work and sitting in the truck for hours, loud fights between Glen and Marian over money at night, Marian taking a second job cleaning offices at night, Nora stopping eating and losing weight, Nora keeping to her room and distance from Marian, Walter drinking again after six years, and by June Nora was eating again and made the track team. The shifts in symptom, functioning, and relationship moves pile up as Glen struggled with unemployment and the family's tension ran high.

clusters.name: Wilma moved into Nora and Hollis's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma moving into Nora and Hollis's house in January 1990, within the year and a half: Nora and Wilma clashing over the children's bedtimes and meals, Hollis working late and keeping out of the rows, Hollis taking his mother's side, Owen's tantrums at preschool, Wilma taking over Lily's care, Nora's eczema flaring on both hands, Nora and Hollis's rows most nights, and Wilma taking a flat in town in June 1991 where the eczema cleared over that summer. The shifts in symptom and relationship moves pile up as the household was reshaped by Wilma's arrival and the tensions it brought.
